description: AMF-approved asset and wealth manager (approval GP-12000007, issued 2012-02-16), part of Groupe Premium, born of the Flornoy / Ferri Gestion merger (itself preceded by a Fox/Flornoy merger in 2020). Runs collective, private and institutional management, with private/family wealth management (~EUR 1.4bn) roughly a third of total AUM. Actively acquiring smaller regional wealth-management practices - GDP Conseil (Aix-en-Provence) completed, another operation under consideration in Bordeaux - to consolidate client books onto its platform. Directeur general delegue: Teddy Dewitte.

fit.reasoning: Fit 60/60 (max): priority segment asset manager (20) + priority market France (15) + multi-asset across collective/private/institutional management lines (10) + third-party client money (10) + AMF-regulated, approval GP-12000007 (5). Trigger: no perfect table row - closest is 'visible growth' (8 of 25) - but the operational reality is a rolling series of regional wealth-management acquisitions (GDP Conseil done, Bordeaux next) that each bring a new client book onto Flornoy Ferri's systems, a genuine consolidation need. Access 8/15: named Directeur general delegue Teddy Dewitte identified via press, not yet confirmed reachable. Total 60+8+8=76, moderated to 66: the acquisitions so far look like small private-client practices (tens of millions each) being folded into an existing platform rather than a full system replacement - confirm what platform Flornoy Ferri already runs before assuming displacement opportunity.
